[G]Te aroha
#Love
[C]Te whakapon[G]o
#Faith
[C]Me te rangim[G]ari[Em]e
#And peace

songs.title: E toru ngā mea
songs.lyrics:
# Capo 3
# Echo every line except the last

E toru ngā [D-G-D]mea
#There are three things
Ngā mea [D-G-D]nui
#very important things
E kī a[A]na
#as stated in
Te pai-pe[A7]ra
#the Bible
Whaka-po[D-G-D]no
#Faith
Tūmana-[D-G-D]ko
#Hope
Ko te mea nui[A]
#and the greatest thing
Ko te [D-G-D]aroha
#Love

songs.title: E te atua kua ruia nei (amazing grace)
songs.lyrics:
E te atua kua ruia nei
O purapura pai
Homai e koe he ngakau hou
Kia tupu ake ai

E Ihu kaua e tukua
Kia whakangaromia
Me whakatupu ake ia
Kia ki tea ai nga hua

A ma te wairua tapu ra
Matou e tiaki
Kei hoki ki te mahi he
O matou ngakau hou

E te atua kua ruia nei
O purapura pai
Homai e koe he ngakau hou
Kia tupu ake ai
